title: 緋色の舞踏会と忘却の書架 ―双子の王冠、偽りの調べ―
author: 蘭 マリア

en.title: The Scarlet Masquerade and the Library of Oblivion: Twin Crowns, a False Melody
en.premise: Deep within the gold-leafed Imperial Capital, behind the opulence of the royal court, exists an 'other Crown Prince' erased from the annals of history. A shadow prince hiding in a second-hand bookstore, a maid harboring the pride of a fallen noble, and ambitious diplomats—their paths intersect upon the stage of a single night's masquerade ball. The truths hidden behind masks and the fires of forbidden love will transform into a grand waltz that shakes the very fate of the empire.

zh.title: 绯色舞会与遗忘书架 ——双生王冠，虚假的旋律——
zh.premise: 在金箔点缀的帝都最深处，在极尽奢华的宫廷背后，存在着一位从历史中被抹去的“另一位皇太子”。潜身于旧书店的影子王子、怀揣没落贵族尊严的侍女，以及心怀野心的外交官们，以一场一夜的假面舞会为舞台，命运交错。面具下隐藏的真相与禁忌之恋，终将化作动摇帝国命运的壮丽圆舞曲。
